project_title: Cosa Fare a Potenza - Social Radar PWA
app_context: Mobile-first PWA social radar and event discovery platform for Potenza, Italy. Inspired by SOMO and MoVita. All UI text in Italian.

layout_strategy.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#0B0B0F] text-gray-100 relative pb-24 shadow-2xl border-x border-white/5
layout_strategy.header: sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0B0F]/80 border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
layout_strategy.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-md z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#16161F]/90 border-t border-white/10 px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-around
layout_strategy.central_plus_button: relative -top-5 w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 via-purple-500 to-violet-600 p-[2px] shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(236,72,153,0.5)] active:scale-95 transition-transform

explore_feed.search_bar: Search by venue, event name or hashtag with instant visual filter
explore_feed.featured_carousel: In Evidenza Stasera horizontally scrollable cards with neon badge and live attendee counter
explore_feed.trending_ranking: Dove va Potenza stasera top 3 ranked spots with live fire index
explore_feed.event_list: Glassmorphic event cards with image thumbnail, time, location, distance, trend badge, save icon, and quick vote count

contents: Event title, venue name, address, date & time

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
Keep mobile phone aspect ratio container (max-w-md centered) on desktop for true PWA feel.
Use Vaul bottom sheet or Radix dialog customized as bottom sheet for mobile interactions.
Do NOT use pure black background for cards, use #16161F with backdrop blur and subtle white/10 borders.
Provide full interactive mock data for Potenza (e.g., Piazza Mario Pagano, Via Pretoria, Macchia Romana, Potenza Centro, Parco Montereale).
Enable full CRUD for events & spotted posts stored in state/localStorage so changes persist.
Include Admin PIN modal/toggle so reviewers can easily manage pending items and test boost buttons.
